analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 4 consecutive trading days. RSI declined from 49.2 to 40.5, then to 41.6, and finally to 38.3, entering oversold territory. Weekly ADX at 48.0 confirms a clear trend, but the daily ADX at 23.8 is in the early stages of trend formation. The current price of $33.72 is below the SMA50 ($34.00) but above the SMA100 ($32.97). The price is trading within the range of the swing support at $31.61 and resistance at $34.24. CCI is at -124.4 in oversold territory, and Stochastic %K is at 10.3, also in oversold territory. Insufficient indicator alignment to determine a clear buy/sell direction.
